title: Aspen Institute Business & Society Summit — Eric closes with Ellen McGirt fireside on Incorruptible
summary: Aspen Institute's annual Business & Society Program summit closes with a keynote interview between Eric and Ellen McGirt (Design Observer) on Incorruptible — how to design a corporation to keep founder intentions secure against short-term pressures from public and private capital markets alike. Room includes Wharton Vice Dean Witold Henisz and former Starbucks/Levi's Chief Sustainability Officer Michael Kobori among the leaders reflecting afterward.
blockquote: A memorable closing interview by Ellen McGirt of Design Observer with Eric Ries on his new book, Incorruptible, and the design of the corporation to keep founder intentions secure against the short-term pressures from both public and private capital markets.
blockquote_source: Judy Samuelson, Executive Director, Aspen Institute Business & Society Program
attribution_title: Annual convening on the role of business in society
